summary.name: Smederee
summary.one_liner: Smederee is a self-hostable-listed platform for building software together, offering code hosting, issue tracking, and code review built around the Darcs version control system.
use_cases: tracking issues and managing a software project
reviewing patches via email and a web interface
giving read-only repository access to users without accounts
summary.what_it_does: Smederee provides hosted code repositories for the Darcs version control system, with fine-grained access control, including read-only access for users without an account. It offers issue tracking and project management that integrates with email and mailing lists. Code review is done by handling patches via email alongside a web-based interface. The page lists continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) as "coming soon," so it is not yet available. The listing describes the project as AGPL-3.0 licensed and written in Scala.
notable: Built around the Darcs version control system rather than Git
Email-driven patch review combined with a web interface
Read-only repository access for users without an account
Issue tracking integrated with email and mailing lists
caveats: CI/CD integration is listed as coming soon and is not yet available
Pricing and hosting options are not stated on the page; licensing comes from the awesome-selfhosted listing
